test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Under which ministry was Tele Counselling through SAMVEDNA started for children impacted by the Covid-19 pandemic in India in 2021?

options.text: Ministry of Women and Child Development

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Women and Child Development.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• For children afflicted by the **COVID-19 Pandemic**, **SAMVEDNA **(Sensitizing Action on Mental Health Vulnerability through Emotional Development and Necessary Acceptance) was introduced in **September 2020.**
 
• Through SAMVEDNA, the **National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR)** offers **telecounseling **to kids.
 
• **Three types **of youngsters are to receive tele-counselling. 
 
• Here are some of them:
 
 
• **Children **whose **parents passed away **as a result of **COVID-19.**
 
• **Children **at **COVID care facilities **under **quarantine**.
 
• Children whose **parents **or other **relatives **had a **COVID-19 **positive result.
 
 
 
• SAMVEDNA's primary goal is to offer **psychological first **aid and **emotional **assistance to children impacted by COVID-19.
 
• The National Commission of Child Rights, is a division of the **Ministry of Women and Child Development**.
 
• Experts from the National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences, including **psychologists, counsellors, **and **specialists. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• In order to address the **anxiety **experienced by **abandoned **and **orphaned children **following the loss of family members due to **COVID**-**19**, The **SAMVAD **at **NIMHANS **is launching a four-part special series.
 
• This will arm those working in the field of **mental health, child protection officials**, and any other concerned people.
 
• It will give service providers and carers specific **strategies **for telling **children bad news **and **assisting them **in **processing **their **feelings **of **loss **and **sadness**.
